newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends firm, market said rangebound.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends firm, market said rangebound.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed firm with the market said rangebound in a typical holiday-type market, traders said.
"It's a typical holiday market and is rangebound," a trader said.
Traders said farmers remained willing sellers, through country elevators, at the current prices. The overseas market, especially the benchmark Thai price, appears weakening.
Rice closed one to 2-1/2 cents per cwt higher, with January up one at $10.46 per cwt.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 200 contracts, below the 376 traded Friday, according to the CBOT.
